item.title: MJR Morning Brief — November 25, 2026
item.description:
From Media Jobs Report, this is the MJR Morning Brief.
The NAB Leadership Foundation’s Celebration of Service to America television special will air nationwide beginning November 28. Tamron Hall will be joined by stars from radio, television and entertainment to recognize local broadcasters making a difference in their communities. The one-hour special runs through December 27.
In radio news,
The Steve Harvey Morning Show and Premiere Networks are celebrating Thanksgiving with their 17th annual Turkey Give. More than seven thousand turkeys and gift cards have been distributed through affiliate radio stations nationwide to help families in need enjoy the holiday. Participating markets include New York, Chicago, Philadelphia, Dallas, Atlanta, Washington, Seattle, Detroit and Huntsville, Alabama. Since launching in 2009, the initiative has distributed more than 130 thousand turkeys to individuals and families in need.
Turning to television,
NBCUniversal has unveiled its Thanksgiving programming lineup, featuring the 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade, the National Dog Show and NBC’s 50th Thanksgiving NFL broadcast, with the Kansas City Chiefs facing the Buffalo Bills. Jimmy Fallon and Justin Timberlake will close out the holiday with a special Tonight Show.
In radio news,
AM/FM radio continues to dominate listening behind the wheel. New research from Edison Research at SSRS shows broadcast radio captures 53 percent of in-car audio listening, followed by streaming music at 17 percent, SiriusXM at 16 percent and podcasts at 6 percent.
Turning to ratings,
Eastlan Ratings has announced that veteran radio sales executive Joe Costello will join the company after the holidays. Costello currently serves as Senior Vice President of Sales at Gen Media Partners and brings five decades of radio sales experience, including nearly 30 years with The Tacher Company. Eastlan President Mike Gould says Costello’s relationship-building skills and ability to help stations turn audience data into revenue will benefit the company.
And finally,
New Country ninety-six point three’s Hawkeye and Michelle are taking their annual Ten Thousand for the Troops campaign nationwide. Through a partnership with Scouting America, Cub Scouts across the country are helping send holiday cards and letters to military service members stationed away from home.
